newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Oct 14.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Oct 14.

text.p: * Johnson & Johnson is expected to report third quarter earnings per share of $0.55, up from $0.48 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 51-1/2 on Friday.
* Intel Corp is expected to report third quarter earnings of $1.25 a share, up from $1.02 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock was down 1/2 at 104-7/8 in London.
* ENOVA Corp and Pacific Enterprises said they would merge into a new company with a market value of $5.25 billion. ENOVA closed at 22-1/2 and Pacific Enterprises closed at 31-1/2.
* Boise Cascade Corp is expected to report a third quarter loss per share of $0.28, compared to a profit of $1.73 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 33.
* First Union Corp is expected to report third quarter earnings per share of $1.59, compared to $1.36 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 67-5/8.
* Time Warner Inc is expected to report a loss of $0.40 a share compared to a loss of $0.30 in the year-ago period, according to First Call. The stock closed at 41-3/4.
* Travelers Group Inc is expected to report third quarter earnings per share of $1.06, compared to $0.90 in the year-ago period, according to First Call. The stock closed at 51-7/8.
